items.stem: It is ______ that Wang Zhenyi is remembered for her great work.
items.note: 横线手写词辨为 fact（卷面横线前未印冠词，按字面转写）

items.stem: Some people think writing letters is ______ but I like it very much.
items.note: 手写词辨为 outstanding（语境疑应为 outdated，按字面转写）

items.stem: Though he passed away at a young age, his spirit lives ______ his short lifetime.
items.note: 手写单词潦草，辨为 beyond（首字母 b 清晰，后半辨读）

items.stem: Mary is ______ that she can achieve her goal as long as she keeps making efforts.
items.note: 手写词辨为 confident

items.stem: ______ is fitting that hard work finally leads to good results.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B；选项 B. It 处有手画圈，与页边一致

items.stem: Scientists are convinced ______ the importance of protecting the environment.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 A（其横画长长延伸，压到选项行）

items.stem: ______ his achievements in science, he is an excellent artist.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B（草写形似 ß/ℬ）

items.stem: The young girl ______ acting, and she practises it day and night.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B（卷面为英式拼写 practises）

items.stem: People were made ______ that eclipses were a sign of anger from heaven in the past.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 C；选项 C 被手画圈，与页边一致

items.stem: The computer needs ______. I think I need ______ to ask Mr Zhang for help.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 C（形近圆弧）；选项 C 被圈，A、B 有划线

items.stem: Wang Zhenyi was ______ male scientists of her time.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B

items.stem: This salad ______ fresh vegetables and fruits, and the juice ______ grapes.

options.t: is made by; is made of
is made up of; is made of
is made by; is made from
is made up of; is made from

items.note: 题号左侧页边手写字形辨为 B（与 7/8/11 题同一草写体）；但选项区 A、B 前有划线、D 前有类似勾选记号，疑学生最终改选 D，页边字母与选项标记不一致 页边原写 B，选项区 A/B 被划掉、D 前有勾，按最终作答记 D（用户确认）。

items.stem: Practice is ______ talent.
These vegetables in the garden ______ every day, or they will die.
items.cn: 花园里的这些蔬菜每天都需要浇水，否则它们会死的。

items.stem: ______ English movies, I also listen to English songs to learn English.
items.cn: 除了看英文电影，我还听英文歌曲来学习英语。

items.stem: Nancy was famous for ______ for playing the piano when she was a child.
items.cn: 南希从小就因弹钢琴有天赋而出名。
items.note: 横线上先写 being talented 并划掉，上方改写为 having a talent（空后 for 为印刷体） 横线上先写 being talented 被划掉，改写 having a talent；此处只保留最终作答。

items.stem: ______ we learn from great people and ______ their spirits ______.
items.cn: 我们向伟人学习，并牢记他们的精神，这是理所应当的。
items.note: 句首两处横线上手写 It is fitting；and 后横线写 that；their spirits 之后的横线未填写

items.stem: The model of lunar eclipse ______ several simple things, and she made it ______.
items.cn: 这个月食模型由几样简单物品组成，并且是她独自完成的。
items.note: 第二个空移至下一行行首，学生写 on her own

items.stem: I'm sorry ______ I broke your glass just now.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 A；选项 A 印刷为斜杠 /（即不填）

items.stem: I am not certain ______ the new student will join our English Club or not.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 C

items.stem: My grandma is worried that it ______ rainy tomorrow.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B

items.stem: I'm curious ______ the Northern Lights usually appear in the polar regions.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B

items.stem: It was truly surprising ______ a small team of only five people completed such a huge project.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 C

items.stem: —I'm not sure if he ______ tomorrow. —Don't worry. I think if he ______, he will give you a call.
items.note: 题号左侧页边手写 B

items.stem: We're certain ______ something is wrong with him, but we are unsure ______ he will die of the disease.
items.note: 本页正文到 disease. 结束，第 25 题选项未印在本页（疑在下一页或照片未拍到），故 options 为 null；题号左侧页边有手写 A
